name: Claude Code Skills Integration for Multi-Agent Coordination
description: Integrate Claude Code Skills to reduce context usage by 30-40% through progressive disclosure of Redis patterns, CFN loop workflows, SQLite memory access, and automated hook pipeline execution.

strategicValue.contextEfficiency: Skills load coordination patterns only when needed (progressive disclosure)
strategicValue.consistency: Redis/CFN/ACL rules encoded in skills - eliminates prompt drift
strategicValue.autonomy: Claude selects skills automatically - reduces coordination questions
strategicValue.maintainability: Update skill once - all agents get latest patterns

phases.name: Core Coordination Skills
phases.description: Eliminate repetitive Redis coordination and agent spawning explanations through skills

sprints.name: Redis Coordination Skill
deliverables: SKILL.md with hierarchical and mesh patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Claude autonomously selects Redis pattern (hierarchical vs mesh) based on agent count
LPUSH/BLPOP patterns correctly implemented (not pub/sub)
Timeout handling included in all blocking operations
Channel naming convention documented and enforced
Test coverage: 100% pattern selection accuracy in 10 test scenarios

sprints.name: Agent Spawning Skill
acceptanceCriteria: CLI spawning pattern with explicit --agents flag documented
Cost optimization explained ($0 coordinator vs $0.50)
Topology selection rules encoded (mesh vs hierarchical)
Redis integration patterns for spawned agents
Test coverage: 100% correct agent type selection in 10 test scenarios

sprints.name: CFN Loop Validation Skill
acceptanceCriteria: Mode-dependent thresholds encoded (MVP/Standard/Enterprise)
Auto-retry logic until consensus reached (no manual checks)
SQLite memory integration for evidence chain
Automatic validator spawning based on mode
Test coverage: 100% correct mode selection and threshold enforcement

successMetrics.autonomousSelection: 100% Redis pattern selection without manual intervention

phases.name: Memory & Hooks Integration
phases.description: Enable persistent state and automated quality gates through SQLite and hook pipeline skills

sprints.name: SQLite Memory Access Skill
acceptanceCriteria: 5-level ACL model documented (Agent/Team/Swarm/Project/System)
Query patterns for each ACL level with encryption enforcement
Redis hot cache + SQLite cold storage integration
TTL management rules by data type
Test coverage: 100% ACL enforcement validation

sprints.name: Hook Pipeline Skill
deliverables: SKILL.md with post-edit automation and feedback handling
feedback-resolver.sh (auto-resolution logic for each feedback type)
acceptanceCriteria: Automatic hook execution after Edit/Write/MultiEdit
ROOT_WARNING auto-resolution (move file to suggested location)
TDD_VIOLATION semi-auto handling (prompt to write tests)
Redis feedback integration for CLI-spawned agents
Test coverage: 100% ROOT_WARNING resolution, 90% TDD_VIOLATION handling

sprints.name: Test Execution Skill
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinator runs tests ONCE before spawning workers
Workers ONLY read test-results.json (never run tests)
Redis coordination for test completion signaling
Cleanup pattern after all work complete
Test coverage: Zero concurrent test execution conflicts in 20 test runs

successMetrics.statePersistence: Agents persist state autonomously across sessions

phases.name: Testing & Refinement
phases.description: Validate autonomous decision-making, optimize skill descriptions, and achieve 40% context reduction

sprints.name: Skill Invocation Analytics
deliverables: Analytics dashboard for skill selection accuracy
acceptanceCriteria: All skill invocations logged with context and outcome
Dashboard shows skill selection accuracy per skill
Token reduction measured before/after skill integration
Mismatched invocations flagged for description refinement
Test coverage: 100% invocation logging accuracy

sprints.name: Skill Description Refinement
deliverables: Updated SKILL.md descriptions based on usage data
Accuracy report showing improvement over baseline
acceptanceCriteria: Skill invocation accuracy ≥95% for all skills
Description updates based on ≥20 real-world invocations per skill
Context reduction ≥40% measured across 50 test prompts
Manual override rate <5% for all coordination tasks
Test coverage: 95% accuracy validated in 100 test scenarios

sprints.name: Production Rollout
acceptanceCriteria: CLAUDE.md references skills exclusively (manual coordination removed)
Rollback plan tested with <10% accuracy degradation scenario
Monthly review process documented with example audit
Quarterly audit process defined with success metrics
Test coverage: 100% rollback success in 5 test scenarios

backlog.description: Security audit skill for automated vulnerability scanning
backlog.reason: Requires integration with external security tools (defer to v2)

backlog.description: Performance profiling skill for automated bottleneck detection
backlog.reason: Lower priority than core coordination skills

backlog.description: Documentation generation skill for auto-generated API docs
Multi-language support for skills (Python, Rust, Go)
backlog.reason: JavaScript/Bash coverage sufficient for current needs

epicAcceptanceCriteria: All 6 core skills implemented and tested (Redis, Agent Spawning, CFN Loop, SQLite, Hooks, Test Execution)
Context reduction ≥40% measured across 50 test prompts
Skill invocation accuracy ≥95% validated in 100 test scenarios
Manual override rate <5% for all coordination tasks
Zero concurrent test execution conflicts in 20 test runs
Agents persist state autonomously across sessions

skills_selected_incorrectly.mitigation: Iterative description refinement based on invocation logs

context_usage_increases.mitigation: Rollback plan + parallel operation in Week 1

acl_violations.mitigation: SQLite query validation in skill tests
